ja: 伝説の白鋼、レジェンドＢＢで、今、甦る！！ ＬＥＧＥＮＤＢＢ 二代目大将軍、幻の‘白鋼Ｖｅｒ．’登場！！
銀メッキと銀の成形色で、‘白鋼’へとパワーアップを遂げた二代目大将軍を豪華に再現。
ＢＢ戦士ファン必携、あの伝説の姿‘白鋼Ｖｅｒ．’を、レジェンドＢＢシリーズキットで商品化。
●　銀メッキ加工＆銀の成形色で‘白鋼’を再現!
角飾り、鎧の一部には、光沢の銀メッキ加工を施行。
鎧や日輪剣などには、銀色の成形色を採用し、グロスインジェクション成形で艶感のある仕上がり。
●　雷凰頑駄無用の換装鎧一式が付属！
●　遊びの幅が広がる多彩なギミックを搭載！
武者フォートレス、武者フェニックスに変形可能。
軽装形態再現可能。バトルマスク装着可能。ヘッドバスター、大目牙砲は、肩越しへの展開が可能。
ノンスケール組み立て式プラモデル
対象年齢：15才以上
製品素材：PS・PE
・組み立てに接着剤は使用しません

en: The legendary white steel, Legend BB, is now revived! ! LEGENDBB Second Great General, Phantom 'White Steel Ver. 'Appearance! !
With silver plating and silver molding color, the second generation general who has been powered up to 'white steel' is luxuriously reproduced.
A must-have for BB Senshi fans, that legendary figure 'White Steel Ver. ’ is commercialized with the Legend BB Series Kit.
● Reproduce 'white steel' with silver plating and silver molding color!
The corner ornaments and parts of the armor are plated with shiny silver.
A silver molding color is used for the armor and ring sword, and gloss injection molding gives it a glossy finish.
● Comes with a set of replacement armor for Raiou Gundam!
● Equipped with a variety of gimmicks that expand the range of play!
Can be transformed into Musha Fortress and Musha Phoenix.
Lightly armored form can be reproduced. Can be equipped with a battle mask. Head buster and large fire cannon can be deployed over the shoulder.
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. It is also painted. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Due to the arrangement of parts, there are some parts where the plating is thin. Thank you for your understanding.
